note: Labels made by viewing each stored staging page image. findings are the stored (consolidated) action_interaction findings in stored order. realPage = a real action defect is visible. borderline = judgement call, scored as noise in the headline and reported as sensitivity. No story text stored. realMatch = analysis-only keywords: a re-run finding on a real page counts as hitting the real defect when its description contains one of them and is not a gaze comparison ("declared looking"). SET 2 (added 2026-10-09 later): pages with src "set2-2026-10-09" were labelled at PAGE level only (storedFindings carry the page label, not a per-finding verdict); candidates were located through stored non-gaze serious action_interaction findings, so recall on them is re-detection recall, not discovery recall. Borderline = view/orientation or unverifiable-identity calls, scored as noise.
